newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australian jobless a major problem - Opposition.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australian jobless a major problem - Opposition.

text.p: The Australian Opposition said on Tuesday Australian was facing a major unemployment problem after a survey showed business expected a further employment decline during the December quarter.

"The ACCI survey of business confidence, in association with the long-term unemployed figures, suggest that Australia as a nation has a major problem," Opposition employment spokesman Martin Ferguson told reporters.
The Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (ACCI) and Westpac Bank survey said an unchanged 41 percent of businesses reported declining employment in the September quarter.
